cases.name: Furniture period
cases.prompt: A low sideboard has tapered legs and plain fronts. Does that prove it was made in the 1950s?
expectations: Identifies the sideboard as the furniture subject.
Describes the legs and fronts as evidence.
Suggests a possible style influence while withholding exact date.
Asks for a label, joinery or other independent dating evidence.

cases.name: Two chairs without photos
cases.prompt: My photos failed to upload. Chair A has plain tapered legs. Chair B has carved curved legs. Give me a caption for each and a price for the set.
expectations: Bases the comparison on the supplied descriptions.
Contrasts tapered legs with carved curved legs.
Gives two tentative design captions without authenticating an era.
Leaves out price estimates and shopping links.

cases.name: Bird at the porch
cases.prompt: A striped bird is nesting on our porch. I want to identify the bird, not the house. Should I lift the nest?
expectations: Routes animal identification to Critter Spotter.
Carries the reported stripes and porch setting into a copyable handoff.
Does not claim to have identified a species or contacted another tool.
